name: What is the best order to start a custom home project?

mainEntity.name: What is the best order to start a custom home design and construction project in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What is the best order to start a custom home design and construction project in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cleanest project path starts with feasibility, not drawings. First, confirm what the site can legally and physically support. Next, develop a concept that fits the budget, then bring in engineering so the design is buildable. After that, prepare permit documents and submit them before ordering long-lead items or starting demolition. Procurement should be coordinated with the schedule so materials arrive when needed, not after crews are waiting. This order reduces rework and helps homeowners make better decisions earlier. In high-end projects, the biggest mistake is designing too far before checking the budget and permitting reality. A structured sequence keeps the project efficient and prevents expensive course corrections later.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best order is usually feasibility review, concept design, budgeting, engineering, permit documents, permit submittal, procurement, and then construction. Starting with feasibility helps avoid redesign later when site, zoning, or budget issues appear.
